item.title: Attorney General sues Illinois-based home services broker for deceiving homeowners by posing as local businesses
item.description:
Publication Date: May 11, 2026

Files lawsuit against B.E.S.T GDR, LLC d/b/a Premium Home Services and owner Yosef Bernath for wide range of violations of Minnesota law
